elements.element: Customer owns deliverables and work product created for it
elements.evidence: the Company shall own all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Site and all deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement

elements.element: Vendor assigns such rights to Customer
elements.evidence: HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in such deliverables and work product.
HDI shall retain ownership of its pre-existing intellectual property

elements.element: Perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables
elements.evidence: grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in the deliverables

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data
elements.evidence: all customer, order, transaction and user data collected through or generated by the Site ... and the Company retains all rights in the Company Data
Nothing in this Agreement shall create joint ownership of the Site, the deliverables, the work product, the Content or the Company Data.

elements.element: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how
elements.evidence: Insert addresses only 'pre-existing intellectual property'; no reference to generic tools or know-how.

elements.element: Perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to Customer
elements.evidence: licence is 'perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free' only; no 'worldwide'

elements.element: Licence rights to use, modify and sublicense deliverables for Customer's business
elements.evidence: No use/modify/sublicense grant over deliverables; licence limited to embedded HDI IP

reasons: All six atomic preferred elements are expressly delivered by new clause 5.5: Customer ownership of deliverables/work product, Vendor assignment, Vendor retention of pre-existing IP, a perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence to any Vendor IP embedded in deliverables, retention of all rights in Company Data, and an express no-joint-ownership statement.

The locked target level (preferred) is fully satisfied; the fallback is not met (no generic tools/know-how ownership, no worldwide/modify/sublicense licence), but the two levels are separate bargains and no fallback-only rights were imported.

Minimality holds: the Agreement was silent on ownership, and a single concise inserted clause is the least intrusive fix; ownership of the Site and Content is a natural part of the same ownership statement and adds no new exception or boilerplate.

Intent preserved: all existing paragraphs (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 5.2, 7.1) are untouched, the 'Company Data' term is defined where used, and no contradiction or dangling mechanic arises with the reciprocal e-mail list provisions in 7.1.
